name: Kingda Ka
description: The tallest roller coaster in the world and the fastest in North America — Kingda Ka is a legendary hydraulic launch coaster at Six Flags Great Adventure launching riders from 0 to 206 km/h in 3.5 seconds up a 139-metre tower before plunging straight back down. The most iconic and historically significant coaster at any Six Flags park in the world. Min 137cm.

name: El Toro
description: The greatest wooden roller coaster in the world — El Toro at Six Flags Great Adventure is a legendary Intamin prefabricated wooden coaster delivering an extraordinary 26 seconds of sustained airtime through a spectacular layout of relentless hills and turns. Consistently voted the greatest wooden coaster on Earth by enthusiasts worldwide. Min 122cm.

name: Nitro
description: One of the greatest and most beloved hyper coasters ever built — Nitro at Six Flags Great Adventure is a spectacular B&M hyper coaster delivering extraordinary airtime over a breathtaking 67-metre first drop and a series of relentless airtime hills. One of the smoothest and most rerideable coasters at any Six Flags park in the world. Min 137cm.

name: Bizarro
description: A spectacular floorless roller coaster at Six Flags Great Adventure delivering seven inversions at 110 km/h in an open floorless vehicle with extraordinary special effects including fire and mist. One of the most intensely themed and entertaining coasters at any Six Flags park. Min 137cm.

name: Batman The Ride
description: A classic and beloved Batman-themed inverted coaster at Six Flags Great Adventure — Batman The Ride is a perfectly designed B&M inverted coaster delivering five inversions at 80 km/h through a spectacular themed layout. One of the most popular and rerideable inverted coasters in New Jersey. Min 137cm.

name: Medusa
description: A classic and beloved floorless coaster at Six Flags Great Adventure delivering seven inversions in an open floorless vehicle — Medusa was the world first floorless coaster when it opened in 1999 and remains one of the most historically significant and entertaining coasters at any New Jersey theme park. Min 137cm.

name: Wonder Woman Lasso of Truth
description: A spectacular giant frisbee thrill ride at Six Flags Great Adventure themed to Wonder Woman — riders are swung in a massive pendulum reaching extreme heights and full 360-degree rotations. One of the most intense and spectacular flat rides at any Six Flags park. Min 122cm.

name: The Joker
description: A spectacular free-fly coaster at Six Flags Great Adventure where seats rotate independently as the train navigates a twisted layout of inversions. The most unique and disorienting coaster experience at Great Adventure. Min 122cm.

name: Green Lantern
description: A thrilling stand-up roller coaster at Six Flags Great Adventure delivering multiple inversions in the unique upright riding position. One of the last remaining stand-up coasters at any American theme park. Min 137cm.

name: Cyborg Cyber Spin
description: A wildly disorienting spinning flat ride themed to Cyborg at Six Flags Great Adventure — riders are spun in multiple directions simultaneously in an extreme multi-axis spinning experience. One of the most intense flat rides at any Six Flags park. Min 122cm.

name: Justice League: Battle for Metropolis
description: A spectacular interactive dark ride at Six Flags Great Adventure placing guests in a 4D battle alongside Superman, Batman, Wonder Woman and the Justice League against supervillains. One of the most entertaining and technologically impressive dark rides at any Six Flags park. Suitable for all ages.

name: Skull Mountain
description: A beloved and classic indoor roller coaster at Six Flags Great Adventure housed inside a giant skull-shaped mountain — Skull Mountain delivers classic indoor coaster thrills in complete darkness with fun special effects. One of the most charming and rerideable family coasters at Great Adventure. Min 107cm.

name: Runaway Mine Train
description: A classic and beloved mine train coaster at Six Flags Great Adventure and one of the most charming and accessible family coasters in New Jersey. Runaway Mine Train has been delighting families since 1974 and is a beloved Great Adventure institution. Min 107cm.

name: Rolling Thunder Log Flume
description: A classic and refreshing log flume ride at Six Flags Great Adventure splashing guests through a dramatic waterfall finale. One of the most popular and beloved water rides at any New Jersey theme park. Min 107cm.

name: Tango
description: A classic and entertaining spinning flat ride at Six Flags Great Adventure delivering fun disorienting rotations. Popular and accessible thrill flat ride. Min 107cm.
